title: GWAS Catalog - NHGRI-EBI Catalog of human genome-wide association studies
description: Manually curated collection of all published genome-wide association studies. Each row is a SNP-trait association with study provenance, p-value, effect size (OR or BETA), and risk-allele frequency. v1.0 schema (34 columns, no MAPPED_TRAIT_URI). Built into a Hail Table keyed by (locus, alleles) with a sentinel ALT for variant-annotation joins; see hvantk/skills/gwas_catalog/SKILL.md.

files.description: Full associations TSV (v1.0, 34 columns), unzipped from the EBI GWAS Catalog full-associations archive. `url` is pinned to the release-specific EBI FTP archive matching this entry's accession (e115 / r2026-04-27): EBI keeps every past release under releases/<year>/<month>/<day>/, and the Catalog publishes on Tuesdays (one day after the nominal Monday release date), so r2026-04-27 lands under releases/2026/04/28/ -- confirmed live via HTTP HEAD (Last-Modified: Tue, 28 Apr 2026). The separate releases/latest/ endpoint (what the drift probe fingerprints, to detect the next release) has since moved on. The legacy api/search/downloads/full endpoint has been retired (404).
